naive_small.description: Scaled Naive-style multi-vector workload. Paper reports MINT speedups of 2.1x to 7.2x with HNSW and 2.1x to 8.3x with DiskANN over PerColumn while meeting recall and storage constraints. PerQuery is retained in the raw checkpoint artifact as a lower-bound baseline, but no exact normalized PerQuery cost is transcribed from the paper text.

weighted_cost.description: Normalized machine-independent query cost on the evaluated query slice.

mean_recall_at_k.description: Average top-k recall across the evaluated queries.

min_recall_at_k.description: Worst-query top-k recall, which catches methods that only optimize easy query patterns.

recall_floor_violation.description: Amount by which the worst-query recall falls below the workload recall target.

storage_indexes.description: Number of distinct index configurations used by the submitted plans.

storage_budget_violation.description: Amount by which the submitted plans exceed the workload index budget.

mean_candidate_multiplier_at_k.description: Average candidate-set size divided by k, penalizing methods that maintain recall by over-retrieving.

max_candidate_multiplier_at_k.description: Worst-query candidate-set size divided by k, catching concentrated over-retrieval on held-out query types.

speedup_vs_per_column.description: Cost improvement relative to the one-index-per-column baseline on the same query slice.
